issues: C5 overstates the customer's contribution by claiming Customer#000001504 alone accounts for 92% of the total US revenue change, while the Machinery segment (Q3) already drives $15.23M (178% of the total change) and a second customer (Customer#000001505) similarly grew from $0 to $7.78M, risking double-counting and misattribution of the growth driver.

C6 asserts that the two new multi-year maintenance-parts contracts caused the US revenue growth, but the CRM records (Q6) only demonstrate correlation (contracts won in late 1996, orders starting January 1997); no counterfactual or controlled analysis isolates these contracts as the causal factor amid concurrent volume effects and segment-driven changes.
